author: KEXP
description: Local Seattle luminaries Caitlin & Brent offer an atmospheric take on country music through the lens of 60s French pop. Live on KEXP, they deliver cinematic arrangements with a performance of "Nightcall" and more.
title: Caitlin & Brent perform "Nightcall" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
